name: 2D Sprite
description: Import settings for 2D sprite textures with point filtering and no mip maps for pixel-perfect rendering.
notes: manage_asset has NO set_import_settings action (earlier revisions of this file encoded one). The valid actions are import, create, modify, delete, duplicate, move, rename, search, get_info, create_folder and get_components, and `path` is required on every one of them. Apply this preset as manage_asset(action: "modify", path: "<asset path>", properties: { ...settingsMap values... }) -- the settingsMap keys above go inside `properties`. manage_asset is in the default-on `core` tool group, so no manage_tools activation step is needed.
